_notes: The providers in the endpoint picker, in this order. Each id has a file <id>.json here; server.js reads the same files. The first one that works on the page is the default for a new visitor.
templates is the file with the shared OpenAI-standard request and response templates; each provider file lays its own endpoints over it.
curated is the shared list of tested models (one list for every router), behind the pickers' curated checkbox.
